body.x: With the support from Gyeongbuk Technopark Company Support Group, Nature Energy Lab will participate in the world’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 to showcase its air purifier Sol-leaf and diffuser Aroma-Wind for solar car.
Nature Energy Lab is the company that develops small household appliances by using renewable energy sources such as solar cells and fuel cells.

Sol-leaf is a solar car air cleaner designed for the purpose of Nature Energy Lab to develop practical products that benefit people. This product operates only by solar energy acting as the basic energy source driving the fan inside to purify the air in the car.

Aroma-Winds also use cylindrical solar cells as their primary energy source without external wires. Therefore, it is an active diffuser that can clean and deodorize air for 4 to 5 hours in the vehicle without the driver pressing the power button.
These products can be used not only in vehicles, but also in homes and offices.

Gyeongbuk Province has formed Daegu Joint Pavilion where 44 ICT convergence ventures and SMEs and three startups will be participating. Major programs include exhibitions, investor pitching, public relations with foreign media, and post-CES review conferences. In CES 2019, Daegu and Gyeongbuk Province exchanged MOU to run joint pavilion in CES for the benefits of both parties, and the joint pavilion has been set up in CES 2020. The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global technology issues and trends at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January.
